_readme: SCHEMA REFERENCE ONLY. Copy to prospects/<handle>.json, fill every value from the prospect's REAL data, then: node build.mjs prospects/<handle>.json. Never deploy this file and never invent a value - an empty/null field deletes its block.
who: who their webinar is for, in their own words
headline: one outcome, with a number or concrete noun, from THEIR offer
subline: the one thing in their audience's way + how the host fixes it

tierC.text: what the host can honestly show today

takeaways.d: a thing attendees can DO afterwards
specific enough a competitor could not paste it
ideally with a number they can run themselves

disclaimer: required if any result is stated
